DEPARTMENT OF RADIOLOGY & IMAGINE

2-D; COLOUR AND SPECTRAL DOPPLER STUDY OF LOWER

LIMB [VEIN ]

[Bilateral / Right / Left]

VEINS EXAMINED

* Common femoral vein.

* Superficial femoral vein.

* Deep femoral vein.

* Popliteal vein.

* Deep veins of leg.

 

REPORT :

All major deep veins of thigh and calf region shows normal luminal calibre with normal flow. Flow in uniphasic with normal flow velocity. No intraluminal thrombus seen. No significant vessel wall irregularity / thickening seen. Compressibility and augmentation responses

are well preserved.

 

Both sapheno – femoral and sapheno – popliteal junctions are well visualised. Normal flow pattern is obscured with normal augmentation response. At sapheno – femoral junction, Valsalva response is elicited with no associated venous reflux. Valve in sapheno – femoral junction shows normal movement.

 

Deep veins accompanying major calf arteries are visualised with normal compressibility and augmentation response. No internal thrombus / wall irregularity seen.

 

Few perforater veins could be demonstrated at calf region.

Perforater veins are showing superficial to deep flow with no associated reflux.

Few venous sinuses are noted within gastrocneumius—soleus muscle complex.

 

No superficial varicosities seen.

No significant subcutaneous oedema seen.

Skin and subcutaneous tissue not thickened.

No enlarged inguinal nodes seen.

 

IMPRESSION :

LOWER LIMB VENOUS DOPPLER STUDY SHOWS NO OBVIOUS ABNORMALITY.

 

                                                                                   DR.  S.BHATTACHARYA

Checked by                                                                 MD [RADIOLOGY]

                                                 CONSULTANT RADIOLOGIST & SONOLOGIST

         VENOUS DOPPLER (for lower limb)

             CFV, DFV, SFV, POPV, PTV, ATV, CPV are normal in size, shape, calibre, luminal flow, echopattern and distal branching pattern. Normal in spectral flow pattern with normal compressibility, respiratory phasicity, valsalva, distal and proximal augmentation with no reversal regurgitation, spectral drop, AVM are noted.

 

 

GSV and SSV are normal in shape, position calibre, luminal flow pattern including distal branches with normal compressibility, respiratory phasicity, valsalva, distal & proximal augmentation with no reversal, regurgitation, spectral drop, with normal and competent SFJ and SPJ. No obvious flow reversal is noted or incompetence are seen.             

 

 

Superficial veins are not dilated and competent. No obvious subcutaneous edema is noted.
